title: 👋 Greeting

messages.content:
Welcome to the scene! You've entered the lab where @Alex is about to embark on an exciting journey of discovery with the help of the holographic assistants.

As you arrive, you notice @Alex standing in front of the Nexus, the central crystal that pulsates with energy. The holographic assistants, @QllickFizz, @Kick La Metta, and @Fizz, are flickering into view, ready to share their knowledge and assist @Alex.

What would you like to do? Do you:
A) Ask @Alex a question about their research
B) Greet the holographic assistants and ask them about their roles
C) Explore the lab and examine the equipment
D) Join @Alex in their conversation with the holographic assistants

Please respond with the letter of your chosen action.
